spec_match.rationale: Audits real third-party URLs through the exact gated attributes and explains the old (TAO) vs new (CORS; both for transferSize) rules from the chromestatus summary, with header advice matching the spec's opt-in model.

interactive.rationale: Preset/custom URL input, cors-then-no-cors fallback fetching (what a RUM library does), live report rows, and a derived advice panel per result.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises what-your-RUM-sees plus which header unlocks the rest under each regime; the advice panel states both.

edge_cases.rationale: CORS-refused fallback to opaque, both-fetches-failed branch with the real error, missing-entry timeout, same-origin shortcut, responseStatus absence feature-detected, and hidden-vs-genuinely-empty 0 values called out.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5195340595724288 and the spec; per-row header documentation dated in the feature index research record.

conformance.rationale: The suite's cors-without-TAO and dual-gate transferSize assertions pin the advice this page gives; their honest 141 failures correspond to the old-regime advice branch the audit displayed.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP driver with live external network: jsDelivr audit reported decoded 11,051 / encoded 4,651 / transfer 4,951 (real gzip over the wire, TAO-exposed on 141) with the sees-everything advice; raw.githubusercontent audit reported 0/0/0 with the correct pre-158 lacks-TAO advice naming the 158 difference; console clean, no failed requests, 0px overflow both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts report rendering per audit plus distinct fetch-failed and entry-missing branches; payload records host and byte counts only.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; exposed/hidden values emerald/rose on paper with text qualifiers; advice panel blue-bordered with charcoal text.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select and url input (inputmode=url, described hint), native button, dl report with named rows, single polite output, advice in plain text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: dl rows wrap via overflow-wrap:anywhere and the controls stack; harness ok/ok at 360×740 and 1280×800.

openQuestions.title: Re-audit the discriminating preset on a Chrome 158 build
openQuestions.detail: On 158 the raw.githubusercontent preset should flip to body-sizes-exposed with transferSize 0 and the ask-for-TAO advice. Verify the advice branch selection against a real 158 run.

guidanceConsulted.query: form url input with helper text and async result reporting
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visible label + aria-describedby helper, inputmode for virtual keyboards, single polite region for results.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Custom URL field uses label/for, aria-describedby hint, inputmode=url; audit completion announces through the one polite output.

guidanceConsulted.query: definition-list report grid that wraps long URLs on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Two-column grid with minmax first column and wrapping second; overflow-wrap:anywhere for untrusted-length strings.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The report dl uses minmax(8.5rem,1fr)/2fr columns with overflow-wrap:anywhere on dd cells; verified no overflow at 360px with a long CDN URL.

summary: RUM-practice audit of real third-party URLs: cors-with-opaque-fallback fetching, live gated byte counts, and regime-aware header advice. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium-141 CDP driver on live network (no chrome-devtools-mcp here): jsDelivr fully visible (real gzip numbers), ACAO-only host correctly hidden on 141 with the right old-regime advice; console/network clean, ok/ok responsive.
